studies.prompt: Edit the supplied Akademia Oli Świnka portrait into a faithful premium 3D character modeling reference sheet. Preserve THIS cheerful pink girl pig's unmistakable face: soft broad pear-shaped face, plump integrated cheeks, short broad oval pig snout with two deep oval nostrils, correctly spaced large warm brown almond-shaped eyes set naturally into the face with delicate eyelashes, curved eyebrows, rounded floppy triangular pig ears, and a warm smiling mouth. Preserve the black tricorn with its exact gold piping and gold pig-and-crossbones emblem, the red head band and prominent rose-pink bow on the side of the hat. Preserve her crimson red richly embroidered captain's coat, black-and-gold lapels, cream ruffled shirt and red neck scarf with gold brooch. Do not give her a frog face, protruding spherical eyeballs, detachable cheek balls, a long snout, a black coat, or a generic pirate redesign. Remove the circular medallion frame, map background and compass prop. Make a production character sheet on a plain light warm-gray studio background, landscape composition: three consistent full-body views of the SAME exact pig, front, 3/4 and true side profile, in a relaxed neutral A-pose with hands empty, and one large detailed front head study. The head study should be the main focal point and show that the face matches the source. Tasteful natural lower body extension with brown boots. The face and costume must remain consistent between views. Render as a beautifully sculpted, richly painted, high-end stylized 3D character with smooth continuous anatomy, soft warm studio light, convincing fabric and soft pink skin. Keep the charming expression and exact identity of the reference; avoid plastic toy, primitive-assembly look and exaggerating the mouth. No text, labels, UI, vehicles, scene, logos beyond the existing hat emblem, borders, or watermark. This is a reference sheet for modeling, not a game screenshot.
